14

Cancel cancels

waiting on you

"if I press cancel instead of save, it actually removes it, which is weird"

was wrong

You were right, and it went deeper than the date. Clearing the field called Store.save() on every keystroke, so Cancel had nothing left to undo. It was written that way to work around Save doing nothing at all on a branch — measured: Store.save() called zero times, the refusal swallowed into a toast, the dialog closing as if it had worked.

now

Root cause fixed: the branch gate treated a top-level branch as "not filed in a branch", because it has no parent. A branch is the location. Save works on a branch now, so nothing applies early — the dialog writes nothing until you press Save.

BEFORE

No picture: this is about what is in your planner after you press a button, not how something looks. The check presses Backspace then Cancel and asserts the date survived.

15

A blank task never survives

waiting on you

"the new update somehow made a new task, and it’s basically empty"

was wrong

It was not the update — your previous build has the identical handlers, five of them, same creator. A double-click on empty calendar space has always created a task and opened Edit on it. What was missing is the other half: close that dialog without naming it and the blank task stayed forever.

now

A task created blank and left blank is taken back out when the dialog closes. Anything with a name, notes or children is never touched.

BEFORE

No picture: the point is a task that is no longer there.
